title: Vortex Suggest Objects Loading State
description: When right-clicking a vortex and clicking Suggest objects, the menu briefly shows no collision-free placement before results arrive. Fix so waiting is not displayed as no solution.
summary: Suggest-objects menu and engagement rows now show human-readable object kind and vortex kind labels via brushCandidateDisplayLabels (catalog label/name/id lookup). Replaced generic v0/v1 indices. Kind catalogs are published to puzzle3dBrushKindCatalogsRef for the viewport menu and passed into buildPuzzle3dPlayEngagement from the play shell.
